import { type FeatureDuration, type FeatureDurations } from '../core/history'

export const isRecord = (value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> =>
  typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value)

export const isFeatureDuration = (value: unknown): value is FeatureDuration => {
  if (!isRecord(value)) return false
  if (typeof value.dir !== 'string' || typeof value.id !== 'string' || typeof value.name !== 'string') return false
  if (typeof value.startedAt !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(value.startedAt)) return false
  if (value.ms === undefined && value.completedAt === undefined) return true
  return typeof value.ms === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value.ms) && value.ms >= 0 &&
    typeof value.completedAt === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value.completedAt)
}

export const readFeatureDurations = (value: unknown): FeatureDurations | undefined => {
  if (!isRecord(value)) return undefined
  return Object.entries(value).every(([dir, item]) => isFeatureDuration(item) && item.dir === dir)
    ? value as FeatureDurations
    : undefined
}

// The text the spinner adds after its word while Claude works on the active feature
// (contracts/spinner.md). Pure: no $.
import { duration } from './duration'
import type { SessionMemo, SpeckitState } from './types'

const DEFAULT_BUDGET = 80
const ENGINE_COLUMNS = 40

const width = (text: string): number => [...text].length

export const cleanTaskText = (text: string): string =>
  text
    .replace(/\[(P|US\d+)\]/g, '')
    .replace(/`/g, '')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim()

export const formatElapsed = (ms: number): string => duration(Math.max(0, ms))

/** Whether this turn worked on the active feature: speckit-implement ran, or a tool touched it. */
const isWorkingOnActive = (state: SpeckitState, memo: SessionMemo): boolean =>
  memo.runningSkill?.step === 'implement' || (state.active !== undefined && memo.touched.includes(state.active.dir))

export const spinnerSuffix = (state: SpeckitState, memo: SessionMemo, now: number, columns?: number): string | undefined => {
  const task = state.currentTask
  if (!state.present || state.active === undefined || task === undefined || !(state.isWorkingOnActive ?? isWorkingOnActive(state, memo))) return undefined
  const budget = columns === undefined ? DEFAULT_BUDGET : columns - ENGINE_COLUMNS
  const head = task.id === undefined ? '… ' : `… ${task.id} · `
  const tail = task.startedAt === undefined ? '' : ` · ${formatElapsed(now - task.startedAt)}`
  const text = cleanTaskText(task.text)
  if (text === '') {
    const bare = task.id === undefined ? undefined : `… ${task.id}${tail}`
    return bare !== undefined && width(bare) <= budget ? bare : undefined
  }
  const full = `${head}${text}${tail}`
  if (width(full) <= budget) return full
  const room = budget - width(head) - width(tail)
  if (room >= 2) return `${head}${[...text].slice(0, room - 1).join('').trimEnd()}…${tail}`
  const bare = task.id === undefined ? undefined : `… ${task.id}${tail}`
  return bare !== undefined && width(bare) <= budget ? bare : undefined
}

// Derives one feature's phase and progress from its files (FR-005). Pure: no $.
import { clarificationCount, hasClarification } from './clarification'
import { parseFrontMatter } from './front-matter'
import { currentTaskOf, parseTasks } from './tasks-parser'
import type { Feature, FeatureFiles, FeatureWarning, FrontMatter, Phase } from './types'

/** The one short form of a phase, for any surface short of room (064 #6). */
export const PHASE_SHORT = { specify: 'spec', clarify: 'clar', plan: 'plan', tasks: 'tasks', implement: 'impl' } as const

export const phaseShort = (phase: string): string => (Object.hasOwn(PHASE_SHORT, phase) ? PHASE_SHORT[phase as keyof typeof PHASE_SHORT] : phase)

const phaseOf = (files: FeatureFiles, front: FrontMatter, done: number, total: number): Phase => {
  if (front.status === 'abandoned') return 'abandoned'
  if (front.status === 'done') return 'done'
  if (files.spec === undefined) return 'specify'
  if (front.track === 'quick') return 'implement'
  if (!files.plan && hasClarification(files.spec)) return 'clarify'
  if (!files.plan) return 'plan'
  if (total === 0) return 'tasks'
  if (done < total) return 'implement'
  if (front.status === 'active') return 'implement'
  return 'done'
}

export const deriveFeature = (files: FeatureFiles): Feature => {
  const front = files.spec === undefined ? {} : parseFrontMatter(files.spec)
  const tasks = files.tasks === undefined ? [] : parseTasks(files.tasks)
  const done = tasks.filter(t => t.isDone).length
  const total = tasks.length
  const warnings: FeatureWarning[] = [
    ...(files.plan && files.spec !== undefined && hasClarification(files.spec) ? ['clarification-after-plan' as const] : []),
    ...(files.unreadable?.includes('spec.md') === true ? ['unreadable-spec' as const] : []),
    ...(files.unreadable?.includes('tasks.md') === true ? ['unreadable-tasks' as const] : []),
    ...(files.deferred === true ? ['loading' as const] : []),
    // A folder with no spec.md says so instead of passing for a feature at specify (054 #19).
    ...(files.spec === undefined && files.deferred !== true && files.unreadable?.includes('spec.md') !== true ? ['no-spec' as const] : []),
  ]
  const currentTask = currentTaskOf(tasks)
  return {
    id: files.dir.slice(0, 3),
    name: files.dir.slice(4),
    dir: files.dir,
    phase: phaseOf(files, front, done, total),
    ...(front.track === undefined ? {} : { track: front.track }),
    ...(front.status === undefined ? {} : { status: front.status }),
    done,
    total,
    ...(currentTask === undefined ? {} : { currentTask }),
    warnings,
    ...(files.spec === undefined || clarificationCount(files.spec) === 0 ? {} : { clarifications: clarificationCount(files.spec) }),
    ...(files.checklist === undefined || files.checklist.total === 0 ? {} : { checklist: files.checklist }),
    ...(files.updatedAt === undefined ? {} : { updatedAt: files.updatedAt }),
  }
}

  ['▸', '>', 'active:'],

  ['░', '.', ''],
]

/** A pane text in the marks a set draws: `unicode` as is, `ascii`, or `words` spelled out. */
export const markText = (text: string, set: 'unicode' | 'ascii' | 'words'): string => {
  if (set === 'unicode') return text
  let out = text
  for (const [glyph, ascii, word] of MARKS) {
    if (!out.includes(glyph)) continue
    if (set === 'ascii' || word === '') out = out.split(glyph).join(ascii)
    else out = out.split(glyph).join(word)
  }
  return out
}

// Separators by level (064 #9): `│` between zones, `·` inside one, never both in a zone.
// Pure: no $.

export const ZONE_SEPARATOR = ' │ '
export const ITEM_SEPARATOR = ' · '

/** Zones of items as one line. A zone bar inside an item is flattened, so a zone never holds both. */
export const joinZones = (zones: readonly (readonly string[])[]): string =>
  zones
    .map(items =>
      items
        .map(item => item.replaceAll('│', '|'))
        .filter(item => item !== '')
        .join(ITEM_SEPARATOR),
    )
    .filter(zone => zone !== '')
    .join(ZONE_SEPARATOR)

{
  "name": "astrolabe",
  "version": "0.140.0",
  "description": "Spec Kit progress and usage governance for Claude Code: a phase rail above the prompt, the next command in the prompt hint, the current task on the spinner, a /astrolabe pane, toasts, update buttons, and a status entry with your usage window.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Jony Santos"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/jonyfs/astrolabe",
  "repository": "https://github.com/jonyfs/astrolabe",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "mod",
    "status",
    "spec-kit",
    "statusline"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "preset": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Preset",
      "description": "Where Astrolabe draws: minimal (status line only), compact (status, band, hint, spinner and the drift alarm) or full (compact plus phase toasts and the pane opening by itself on wide screens)",
      "default": "compact",
      "options": [
        "minimal",
        "compact",
        "full"
      ]
    },
    "flavor": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Flavor",
      "description": "Catppuccin or colorblind-friendly palette for the band colors, or theme to follow Claude Code's light and dark theme",
      "default": "mocha",
      "options": [
        "mocha",
        "frappe",
        "macchiato",
        "latte",
        "colorblind",
        "theme"
      ]
    },
    "checkUpdates": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Check for updates",
      "description": "Once a day, check gstack, the Spec Kit CLI, this project's Spec Kit skills and Astrolabe for updates (one GitHub API call), and offer a button to install each",
      "default": true
    },
    "governUsage": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Govern usage",
      "description": "Keep subagent fan-out under the 5-hour and weekly windows: cap at 60%, hold new subagents from 80%, pause from 88% and resume after the reset",
      "default": true
    },
    "governThresholds": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Govern thresholds per window",
      "description": "JSON object with per-window hold/stop thresholds (e.g., {\"five_hour\":{\"hold\":80,\"stop\":88},\"seven_day_opus\":{\"hold\":85,\"stop\":90}})",
      "default": "{}"
    },
    "quietHours": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Quiet hours (HH:MM-HH:MM)",
      "description": "During quiet hours (e.g., 22:00-06:00) the governor never asks: it applies the default (holds and pauses without asking). Empty or invalid formats mean always ask",
      "default": ""
    },
    "observeUsage": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Observe usage limits",
      "description": "Log what the Governor would hold or pause without blocking tools; takes precedence over enforcement",
      "default": false
    },
    "icons": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Icons",
      "description": "Icons in the footer, band and pane: auto (Nerd Font glyphs in the terminal, emoji in the Desktop app and elsewhere), nerd, emoji or ascii",
      "default": "auto",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "nerd",
        "emoji",
        "ascii"
      ]
    },
    "language": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Language",
      "description": "The language of the pane, the Dashboard, the questions, the toasts and the help: auto (the language you type in), en, pt-BR, es or fr",
      "default": "auto",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "en",
        "pt-BR",
        "es",
        "fr"
      ]
    },
    "askOnLimit": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Ask before holding or pausing",
      "description": "When the governor queues a subagent or pauses Claude, ask you with a list of answers (queue, run now, lift for a while); the cautious default applies at once, and your answer changes it",
      "default": true
    },
    "claudeContext": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Tell Claude about the Spec Kit work",
      "description": "Add one line on the active feature, its current task and the next command to your prompt when it changed, and the constitution's principles when a Spec Kit skill runs",
      "default": true
    },
    "featureSummary": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Summary when a feature finishes",
      "description": "When a feature's tasks are all done, ask a small model (haiku) for a five-line summary, shown in the Session tab; it uses a little of your usage",
      "default": false
    },
    "humanize": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Write like a person",
      "description": "Add short humanizer rules to Claude's system prompt: plain prose, no hype words, no em dashes, facts kept exact",
      "default": false
    },
    "terse": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Terse answers",
      "description": "Ask Claude to answer briefly: lite keeps full sentences, full drops filler and articles; files and commits stay normal prose",
      "default": "off",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "lite",
        "full"
      ]
    },
    "skillModels": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Model per skill",
      "description": "auto sends each Spec Kit and gstack skill's requests with the model and effort it does best with (see the Help tab); switching models re-reads the context, so it costs more on long sessions",
      "default": "off",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "auto"
      ]
    },
    "accessible": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Accessible mode",
      "description": "Text only: ASCII icons, charts as text, no hover styles, no animation and no pictures, for screen readers and plain terminals",
      "default": false
    },
    "footerIn": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Where the footer goes",
      "description": "pane: the bottom of the /astrolabe pane under every tab, the status entry keeping the Spec Kit part and the deciding window; status: the whole footer in the status entry; both",
      "default": "pane",
      "options": [
        "pane",
        "status",
        "both"
      ]
    },
    "liveRows": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Live table rows",
      "description": "What the table above the prompt shows besides the prompt cache and usage limits: agents (subagents running), gates (git hooks and gate scripts), both, or off",
      "default": "both",
      "options": [
        "agents",
        "gates",
        "both",
        "off"
      ]
    },
    "footerSource": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Footer source",
      "description": "Who draws the pane footer: statusline (the bundled jonyfs/statusline renders it under Astrolabe's own lead; needs Node 18 or newer, otherwise the native footer shows) or native (Astrolabe's own chips)",
      "default": "statusline",
      "options": [
        "statusline",
        "native"
      ]
    },
    "footerLines": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Footer lines",
      "description": "How the pane's footer draws its chips: 1 row, or 3 rows in statusline's order (place and git, then the Spec Kit work and the skill, then the model and the limits)",
      "default": "1",
      "options": [
        "1",
        "3"
      ]
    },
    "footerSeparator": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Footer separator",
      "description": "The rule above the pane's footer: solid, thin or none",
      "default": "solid",
      "options": [
        "solid",
        "thin",
        "none"
      ]
    },
    "footerStatuslineMode": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Footer statusline mode",
      "description": "How the bundled statusline runs: live (the default; its pull request, CI, gate and rtk chips draw, filled by background gh and rtk processes) or passive (it starts only read-only git and writes only in a folder of this plugin; those chips are not drawn)",
      "default": "live",
      "options": [
        "live",
        "passive"
      ]
    },
    "footerOmit": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Footer segments to omit",
      "description": "Segment keys of the bundled statusline to leave out of the footer, separated by commas (for example: sevenDayReset,model). Empty by default; a name that is not a segment is ignored",
      "default": ""
    },
    "autoReload": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Reload when a new version lands on disk",
      "description": "After a turn, when the Astrolabe on disk is newer than the one running (a local clone, an update), run /reload-plugins once; off, a toast says to run it",
      "default": true
    },
    "images": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Pictures in the Dashboard",
      "description": "Draw the usage chart as a picture: auto on kitty and Ghostty outside tmux, on for any terminal that shows pictures (iTerm2, WezTerm), off for cell charts",
      "default": "auto",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "on",
        "off"
      ]
    },
    "pullRequest": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Pull request in the footer",
      "description": "Show the branch's open pull request and its checks in the footer, from the gh command, asked at most once every five minutes",
      "default": false
    },
    "bandDensity": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "How much the band shows",
      "description": "full: the rail with every step name when there is room; compact: the current step and the count; minimal: the feature id and its step",
      "default": "full",
      "options": [
        "full",
        "compact",
        "minimal"
      ]
    },
    "paneDensity": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "How roomy the pane is",
      "description": "compact: the rows follow each other; comfortable: a blank row between specs, with the same content",
      "default": "compact",
      "options": [
        "compact",
        "comfortable"
      ]
    }
  }
}
